statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes are R55, I48.91, I49.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring CPT 93229 was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
The denial is based on care being covered by another payer under Coordination of Benefits protocols
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying rhythm disturbances
